rules.title: IPsec not detected
rules.description: No IPsec ESP traffic was detected in the analyzed capture.
rules.recommendation: Verify that the VPN is using IPsec and that ESP traffic is present in the capture.

rules.title: IKEv1 detected
rules.recommendation: Prefer IKEv2 where supported and appropriate.

rules.title: IKE version unknown
rules.description: The IKE version could not be determined from the available evidence.
rules.recommendation: Capture IKE negotiation traffic and verify the configured IKE version.

rules.title: Encryption algorithm unknown
rules.description: The encryption algorithm could not be determined from the available capture evidence.
rules.recommendation: Capture IKE Security Association proposals or provide testbed configuration evidence.

rules.title: AES-CBC encryption observed
rules.description: AES-CBC was observed in the negotiated encryption proposals. CBC does not provide authenticated encryption by itself.
rules.recommendation: Prefer an AEAD cipher such as AES-GCM when supported, while retaining compatibility requirements.

rules.title: Authentication/integrity algorithm unknown
rules.description: The authentication/integrity algorithm could not be determined.
rules.recommendation: Capture the IKE SA negotiation or provide the VPN configuration.

rules.title: SHA-1 integrity observed
rules.description: HMAC-SHA1-96 was observed as an integrity transform.
rules.recommendation: Prefer a SHA-2 based integrity algorithm or an AEAD cipher such as AES-GCM.

rules.title: Key exchange method unknown
rules.description: The key exchange parameters could not be determined from the available evidence.
rules.recommendation: Inspect the IKE Security Association proposal and Diffie-Hellman parameters.

rules.title: Weak Diffie-Hellman group observed
rules.description: A legacy weak Diffie-Hellman group was observed.
rules.recommendation: Replace legacy DH Group 1 with a modern, stronger key exchange group.

rules.title: Legacy Diffie-Hellman group observed
rules.description: DH Group 2 uses a legacy 1024-bit MODP group.
rules.recommendation: Upgrade to a stronger Diffie-Hellman group.

rules.title: Perfect Forward Secrecy disabled
rules.description: No separate Diffie-Hellman exchange was observed for the IPsec CHILD_SA proposal.
rules.recommendation: Enable PFS where supported to provide stronger protection against compromise of long-term keys.

rules.title: IPsec mode unknown
rules.description: Tunnel or Transport mode could not be determined.
rules.recommendation: Capture sufficient ESP evidence or use testbed configuration metadata.
